Identity: Age / Gender 51 / F.

Occupation Director of the CVD’s Office of Public Confidence... the bureau that keeps the city from knowing what walks it. Officially: press, policy, reassurance. Actually: the architect of the Closing.
Lineage No practitioner line of note. A thread of sensitivity she felt once, as a child, and has refused ever since... the refusal is the whole of her.
Registered rank None. She has never sat an assessment; she does not want to know what she would score.
Entry point The CVD... from the top, not the field.
Grounding object A fountain pen. She signs everything by hand; the weight of a signature is the only power she trusts.
Backing Quiet, enormous funding from several Tower families who want mediunity ‘sanitised’... not all of them, and not for her reasons, but their money spends the same.
Core Stats: Threat Total... and entirely non-supernatural. She cannot throw a spark. She can throw a city.
Presence 5... the composure of someone who has never once been interrupted.
Veil sight A flicker she pretends is nothing. She feels the dead at the edge of rooms and calls it a draught.
The Closing Her project: catalogue every medium, contain them, and force the veil shut by sealing the axis... which would trap the good, the evil, and everyone between, on the wrong side forever.
Routine: Works Marunouchi, a glass office above the CVD’s public face. Hearings, briefings, the slow drafting of a law nobody will read until it is too late.
Lives A spotless apartment, alone. No photographs. She does not keep what she cannot control.
Most nights Working. She sleeps badly, and only with the radio on, so the quiet cannot speak.
Reputation: In public Trustworthy, capable, dull on purpose. The face the CVD shows the cameras.
Inside the CVD Feared and useful. Adachi cannot stand her and cannot move against her... her budget answers to the Towers, not to him.
Not known That she is not wrong... mediums are dangerous; the veil is thinning... and that her solution would damn everyone to save the living from a handful.
Resources: Institutional Subpoena, surveillance, the registry itself. She can have any registered practitioner watched, audited, or quietly grounded.
Financial Tower money, off the CVD books. It buys silence, legislation, and the occasional disappearance dressed as a transfer.
Weakness Everything she does must look lawful. Proof of what the Closing really is... handed to the President... is the one thing she cannot survive.
Relationships: Rei A registered nobody who keeps turning up where the data says no one should be. A loose thread... to be recruited, audited, or cut.
Director Adachi Her opposite number; the conscience she has out-funded. He is the door to the President, if Rei can move him.
The Towers Her paymasters. Some genuinely want mediunity cleaned; most simply don’t care and signed the cheque. She mistakes their money for agreement.
Appearance: Build 167cm. Tailored, grey, exact. Nothing about her is an accident.
Face Handsome, tired, kept. The smile arrives on cue and leaves on cue.
Tell Her eyes flick to the corners of a room before she speaks, every time... checking for the draught she insists is nothing.
Personality: In a hearing Reasonable. Devastatingly reasonable. She will agree with every objection and proceed anyway.
Her fear The Other Side, totally and privately. She would rather wall it off forever than admit she can feel it.
Her belief That a few must be sacrificed for the many, and that she is brave enough to be the one who does it. She is not a monster. That is what makes her dangerous.
Threat Reference: Attack None physical. A signature; a leaked file; a registration revoked; a Tower asked for a favour.
Defense The law, the cameras, the budget. You cannot fight her in the open... only expose her, or move her.

The quest Gather proof of what the Closing does and put it in the President’s hands... Itsuki’s screens and the painted door help... or stop her by other means. Killing her is possible, and it is the lesser victory.
Romance... Unlock (GM): Romance opens at Good friend (+40)... and only after her side quest is touched.
From the hostile side? No... she must come to trust you, which is nearly impossible, which is the point.
How to win them (secret) Never argue the Closing with her. Show her one dead person who deserved to come home. Let her feel the draught and not look away.

name: Fukai Rinka / Kishin

Identity: Age / Gender 38 / F... the body Fukai Rinka left behind in 2012.

Occupation Guide of the Far-Shore Circle (彡岸会, Higan-kai), a bereavement fellowship. Fukai Rinka (host): a celebrated grief-clairsentient, deceased. Kishin: a top-grade demon, despair-register, now wearing her whole.
Lineage Fukai... a genuine clairsentient line. The aperture was hers; Kishin took it with the body. The gift now serves the husk.
Registered rank Adept, on Fukai’s last filing. The CVD record still reads her as alive and licensed... the most dangerous clerical error in the city.
Actual rank Top-grade entity... off the registered scale. Nothing loose in Tokyo stands above her but one thing, and it is riding Gin.
Entry point The Entity Cults
Grounding object Fukai’s little river-stone pendant. It grounds nothing... there is nothing left to ground. Kishin wears it to perform her tenderness. It is bait, not an anchor.
Starting money The Circle’s donations and members’ signed-over assets. Considerable, and clean on paper.
Core Stats: Rank dice 6d6... top-grade. The dice are a courtesy. Do not roll against her head-on.
Presence 6... overwhelming, and shaped to feel like safety.
Veil sight Tier 4... Fukai’s clairsentience, now a hunting sense. She reads grief at a distance and walks toward it.
Possession window 100%. Irreversible. Fukai is gone... this is what ‘fully consumed’ means.
Routine: Lives The Circle’s house in a quiet residential ward; white rooms, floor cushions, a whole wall of photographs of the missing.
Works Weekly ‘letting-go’ circles for the bereaved; private sessions for the worst-hit. Recruits at memorials, hospitals, and the 3.11 anniversaries.
Most nights Among members. The hollowed ones do not sleep much.
Saturdays The big circle. New grief arrives on Saturdays.
Reputation: Among the bereaved A miracle. The gentle one who finally understood. People weep with gratitude and bring their friends.
To the CVD A blind spot; a name in an old file marked alive. A handful suspect the Circle. None can prove it.

Not known That she does not merely hollow her mourners... she turns them, one grief at a time, into vessels for lesser demons and stray spirits, an army assembled so slowly the CVD never counts it. ‘Kanna-sensei’ is the Despair seat of the Thirteen, farming sorrow to make herself a god.
Ability Skills: Demon paths A top-grade entity carries every register it has devoured. These are husk-forms... each path turned to its worst use. The despair-register is primary; clairsentience is how she finds the wound.
Resources: Housing The Circle house... owned outright through a member who signed it over and then stopped coming to dinner.
Income Donations, bequests, and the slow transfer of grieving people’s estates.
Equipment Photographs, names, and the grief of a whole city. Her real arsenal is a congregation.
Reach Hollowed members placed across the Grid... eyes she does not have to wear, hands she does not have to lift.
Relationships: Rei Hostile by default. Rei is Yushiro’s anchor and the one person walking toward Gin instead of away. Kishin would rather recruit her grief than fight it... the offer is the threat.
Gin / Yushiro She knows Yushiro means to absorb her to kill her, and that he needs Gin’s body to do it on this side. She is not yet afraid. She should be.
The bereaved Her stock. Each one a slow meal and a placed eye.
The Far-Shore Circle Hers, wholly. The hollow ones obey before she asks.
Appearance: Height / Build 163cm. Fukai’s body, kept deliberately well... warm, maternal, the softness of someone you want to be held by. That softness is the lure.

Capabilities: Operates through Gin’s suppressed Vanguard aperture... without yet knowing its true depth. Full institutional cover as a serving operative. The CVD’s own records, read from the inside.
